gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 512 KiB flash (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF)

rom.name: Pokemon - SoulSilver Version (USA, Australia).nds
rom.note: a dump of this game code whose sha1 is not in the No-Intro DAT (the area after the used ROM size is blank); the region in the name is a guess

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - SoulSilver Version (USA, Australia)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file
